product_updates.title: 6 days left to save up to $200 to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
product_updates.content: Current ticket pricing ends in 6 days on Sept. 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Join 10,000+ founders, investors and tech leaders at Disrupt and save up to $200 on your ticket until then.

product_updates.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
product_updates.content: Everyone in the world-models space is sitting on a pile of cash and a ton of buzz, but good luck getting anyone — from the founders to their own data suppliers — to tell you what they're actually building.

product_updates.title: Is the AI industry really ready to slow down?
product_updates.content: On Equity, we debated whether Ai executives are serious about wanting to slow down.

product_updates.title: ScrollEd wants to turn textbooks into TikTok
product_updates.content: ScrollEd turns textbooks into a scrollable, Instagram-like feed with video, audio, and quizzes. The Palo Alto startup, founded by student co-founders (and spouses) Utsav Gupta and Rebecca Neff, pitches at TechCrunch Disrupt.
